resources.string: The download is verified automatically, then the system installer opens. Services briefly stop for a data snapshot and return to their previous state before installation. The system still asks you to confirm installation.
The update is verified. Allow this app to install APKs in system settings; installation continues when you grant access and return.
APK installation is not allowed yet. The download is kept; check for updates again to continue.
System installer opened. If you cancel, check for updates again to continue without downloading again.
You already have the latest version available for this device.
